resetView.title: Reset view
resetView.description: Return the camera to the venue's default view.

occupancySimulated.title: Simulated occupancy
occupancySimulated.description: Toggle a place's occupancy color with simulated data.

poiClick.title: POI click
poiClick.description: Tap a POI on the map to reveal its details.
poiClick.hint: Tap a POI on the map to see its details here.

gotoPoi.title: Go to POI
gotoPoi.description: Enter a place ID to center and highlight it on the map.
gotoPoi.notFound: No POI found with this ID.

floorSelector.title: Floor selector
floorSelector.description: Switch floors and buildings from a native, app-driven control.

exploreMode.title: Explore mode
exploreMode.description: Switch between global, exploded building carousel, and single-floor views.

computeNavigation.title: Itinerary
computeNavigation.description: Compute and display a route between two place IDs.
computeNavigation.notFound: No POI found for one of these IDs.
computeNavigation.routeNotFound: No route found between these two places.

uiPartVisibility.title: UI visibility
uiPartVisibility.description: Show or hide individual parts of the map's default UI.

simulatedPosition.title: Simulated position
simulatedPosition.description: Animate a simulated position with an accuracy circle between two POIs.
simulatedPosition.notFound: No POI found for one of these IDs.

cameraLockOnPosition.title: Camera lock on position
cameraLockOnPosition.description: Recenter and lock the camera onto a simulated tracked position, GPS-app style.

accuracyCircleStyle.title: Accuracy circle style
accuracyCircleStyle.description: Recolor the tracked position's precision circle, live

geofencing.title: Geofencing
geofencing.description: Trigger a visual alert when a simulated tracked position enters a POI's surface zone.
geofencing.zoneNotFound: No POI found with this ID.
geofencing.zoneNoSurface: This POI has no surface geometry to use as a zone.

clickableSurface.title: Clickable surface
clickableSurface.description: Make a place's surface interactive so the SDK handles its hover/tap color itself.
clickableSurface.notFound: No POI found with this ID.

customData.title: Custom data
customData.description: Read custom business data (price, hours, reference) attached to a POI in VisioMapEditor.
customData.notFound: No POI found with this ID.
customData.empty: No custom data for this POI.

categoryHighlight.title: Category highlight
categoryHighlight.description: Highlight every POI in a chosen category with one tap.

dynamicPoiCrud.title: Dynamic POI CRUD
dynamicPoiCrud.description: Create, update and remove a POI at runtime, without republishing the map.
dynamicPoiCrud.alreadyTracked: Remove the current dynamic POI before creating another one.
dynamicPoiCrud.alreadyExists: A POI with this ID already exists in the venue.
dynamicPoiCrud.anchorNotFound: No POI found with this anchor ID.
dynamicPoiCrud.anchorNoPosition: This POI has no position to copy (no label or marker).

runtimeLocale.title: Runtime locale
runtimeLocale.description: Switch the map's displayed language on the fly, no reload needed.

nativeUiReplacement.title: Native UI replacement
nativeUiReplacement.description: Hide the SDK's own floor selector and drive floors entirely from the app's native control.

addLocale.title: Add locale at runtime
addLocale.description: Register a brand-new language (Spanish) that was never authored in VisioMapEditor, via addLocale().

customBaseUrl.title: Configurable map server
customBaseUrl.description: Point the SDK at a different map server than Visioglobe's default SaaS, via baseURL.

customNavigationTrace.title: Custom navigation trace
customNavigationTrace.description: Compute a route and style its trace with your own brand colors.

navigationExcludeModalities.title: Exclude Modalities/Attributes
navigationExcludeModalities.description: Compute a route while excluding a segment attribute or modality (e.g. elevator) from the routing graph.

accessibleMode.title: Accessible Route
accessibleMode.description: Compute a route restricted to the venue's own accessible path (e.g. lift instead of stairs) via computeNavigation's isAccessible option.

iconMarker3d.title: 3D icon marker
iconMarker3d.description: Place a custom image at a spot on the 3D map

customTextLabel.title: Custom text label
customTextLabel.description: Place your own text on the map and restyle it live

htmlOverlayMarker.title: HTML overlay marker
htmlOverlayMarker.description: Pin a tappable HTML badge on the map that's never hidden by 3D

customTheme.title: Custom theme
customTheme.description: Switch the 3D lighting theme and recolor the SDK's buttons live
customTheme.hint: Tap a place: its card's Go button uses the accent colors.

cameraProjectionToggle.title: Camera projection
cameraProjectionToggle.description: Switch between a 3D perspective view and a flat orthographic view
cameraProjectionToggle.hint: Switching reloads the map (the projection can only be set when the view is created).

cameraShowcaseCarousel.title: Camera showcase
cameraShowcaseCarousel.description: Automatic camera tour of the map, for kiosks and lobby screens
cameraShowcaseCarousel.paused: Paused — resumes after 10 s without touch
cameraShowcaseCarousel.hint: Touching the map pauses the tour; it resumes on its own after 10 s.

authToken.title: Protected map (token)
authToken.description: Code sample: load a map protected by an authorization token
authToken.body: This feature is a code sample only: this demo has no protected map to load. See {file} and {doc}, then replace the placeholder map hash and token with your own values.
